name: @network/root
description: Modular, extensible TypeScript networking stack implementing protocol layers in user space.

scripts.clean:force: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of fs.readdirSync('packages')){for(const b of ['dist','node_modules','.turbo']){try{fs.rmSync('packages/'+d+'/'+b,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}}"
